text: The accel_step control R2 falls from 0.54-0.56 (e<=0.7) to 0.46-0.49 (e<=0.75), while the force control is 0.23-0.33 here. Over e ceilings of 0.5-0.85, does the normalised force margin (0.16-0.22 here) stay roughly constant while the normalised accel_step margin (0.51-0.54 here) falls? That would mean the shrinking force/accel_step gap at high e comes from accel_step getting harder.
